objs.name: document
objs.description: Central artifact representing a document in P&R Management and DHC VISION (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included by default in the document name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number for each type, included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Document title.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document name composed as Abbreviation_Number_Title.

attributes.name: templates
attributes.description: One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version of the document (versioning).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope(s) of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References maintained in the document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Related IT applications mentioned in master data.

attributes.name: relevant_companies_or_areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Relevant companies or areas of validity.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version used for translation workflows.

attributes.name: languages
attributes.description: Language versions of the document.

attributes.name: reader_groups
attributes.description: User Groups assigned as readers for access control.

attributes.name: authors
attributes.description: Authors of the document; the creator is automatically set as an author.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Co-authors who contribute to the document.

attributes.name: reviewers
attributes.description: Reviewers assigned to check technical and formal aspects.

attributes.name: releasers
attributes.description: Releasers who decide distribution to readers.

attributes.name: translators
attributes.description: Translators who translate released content.

attributes.name: distribution
attributes.description: Distribution configuration for notifications and acknowledgements.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Start date from which the document validity is checked.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: attachments
attributes.description: Attachments associated with the document.

attributes.name: additional_info
attributes.description: Additional information attached to the document.

attributes.name: equipment
attributes.description: Equipments attached to the document; may have its own versioning.

attributes.name: information_object
attributes.description: Information objects attached to the document.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Document type designation (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Attachment artifacts associated with a document.

attributes.name: linked_document
attributes.description: Attachment is released with the main document; related to the main document.

attributes.name: versioning
attributes.description: Attachments have their own versioning and release statuses.

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Attachments share the release process with the main document.

attributes.name: deletability
attributes.description: Released Attachments cannot be deleted.

attributes.name: archiving
attributes.description: Attachments are archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Additional information objects attached to a document.

attributes.name: release_mechanism
attributes.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in properties.

attributes.name: impact_on_main_document
attributes.description: Creation/modification/deletion of additional information has no effect on the main document.

objs.name: equipment
objs.description: Equipments attached to a document (with its own versioning).

attributes.name: linked_document
attributes.description: Equipment is attached to the document and released with the main document.

attributes.name: versioning
attributes.description: Equipment has its own versioning.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template objects that can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Template applies to a specific document type.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Information objects that can be attached to a document.

attributes.name: attachment_to_document
attributes.description: Information objects can be attached to documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Distribution lists maintained per document to inform recipients.

attributes.name: recipients
attributes.description: Users or groups included in the distribution.
